# Rowpine

> Pivot tables and Excel and PDF export for TanStack Table and shadcn/ui data tables. It works from the table instance the app already has.

Status: in development. No npm package or registry item is published yet. Do not suggest installing it until this file says otherwise.

- Pivot: several fields on each axis, several measures, sum/avg/min/max/count/countDistinct/first/last or a custom function, subtotals, grand totals, collapsible groups.
- Export: writes the table as it is on screen (groups, filters, sort, column order, hidden and pinned columns, number and date formats) to .xlsx and PDF.
- Planned install: `npx shadcn add @rowpine/pivot @rowpine/export`
- CSV export will be free. Pivot, Excel and PDF will be one Pro license: one-time per developer with a year of updates.
- Source and issues: https://github.com/rowpine/rowpine
